what: Chubb is one of the world's largest property and casualty insurers. It covers businesses of all sizes, wealthy households, farms, and sells accident, health and life insurance in Asia and Latin America.
customers: Companies, affluent individuals and farmers in more than 50 countries.
money: commercial and consumer lines outside the US
high-net-worth home and auto, crop insurance, life
moat: A long record of disciplined underwriting, with claims and costs well below the premiums it collects.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year and about 11% a year over three years
Higher interest rates raise investment income on its large bond portfolio
One of the best underwriting records in commercial insurance
watch: The combined ratio and net premiums written growth.
